author: Your Brand Studio

phase1.name: Studio Baseline
phase1.prompt: Clean studio product shot, single white sneaker rotating slowly on a reflective black pedestal, soft rim lighting, minimal background, premium commercial photography, 24fps, ultra-realistic, shallow depth of field
phase1.negativePrompt: blur, cartoon, low quality, cluttered background

phase2.name: Tech Transformation
phase2.prompt: PRODUCT TECH TRANSFORMATION: sneaker surface dissolves into glowing circuit-board patterns, sole splits open revealing pulsing blue energy core, laces become fiber-optic strands of light, holographic specs and stats orbit the shoe, particle effects burst outward, camera pushes in dramatically, cinematic commercial sci-fi epic
phase2.negativePrompt: ugly, distorted, cartoon, low quality, morphing artifacts

phase3.name: Hero Reveal
phase3.prompt: Energy settles back into the shoe leaving a subtle glowing trim, camera pulls back to a wide hero shot, logo and tagline fade in cleanly, premium studio lighting returns, confident final product reveal

ambient.name: Studio Ambient
ambient.prompt: Subtle premium studio ambience, soft whoosh as camera glides, light synth pad, minimal percussion ticks, clean commercial sound design

transformation.name: Tech Transformation
transformation.prompt: Electric energy charge-up, circuit activation crackle, deep bass synth riser, glass-like chime accents, futuristic UI beep flourishes, big bass drop at the reveal

music.name: Cinematic Brand Score
music.prompt: [Minimal piano and pad intro] [Building electronic percussion and synth layers] [Big drop with driving bass and brass stabs for the transformation] [Clean confident outro chord for the hero reveal] modern commercial cinematic
